This is a newly discovered POKéMON. It is
currently under investigation. No detailed
information is available at this time.
entries.pt:
Este é um▁recém-descoberto POKéMONÉ, sim.
▁actualmente em▁investigação.
A▁informação▁está▁disponível▁neste▁momento.

entries.en:
There is a plant seed on its back right
from the day this POKéMON is born.
The seed slowly grows larger.
entries.pt:
▁Há▁uma▁semente de▁planta na▁sua▁direita▁traseira
▁desde o dia em que esta POKéMON Nasceu.
A▁semente▁lentamente▁cresce.

entries.en:
There is a plant bulb on its back.
When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said
to blossom into a large flower.
entries.pt:
▁Há um bulbo de▁planta em▁suas▁costas.
▁Quando▁absorve▁nutrientes, o bulbo é▁dito
para▁florescer em▁uma flor grande.

entries.en:
A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower.
The fragrance becalms those engaged in
a battle.
entries.pt:
Um aroma▁fascinante▁sai da▁sua flor.
A▁fragrância▁deixa▁os▁envolvidos em
▁Uma▁batalha.

entries.en:
From the time it is born, a flame burns
at the tip of its tail. Its life would end
if the flame were to go out.
entries.pt:
▁Desde que▁nasce,▁uma▁chama▁queima.
na▁ponta da▁sua▁cauda.
Se a▁chama se▁apagasse.

entries.en:
It lashes about with its tail to knock
down its foe. It then tears up the fallen
opponent with sharp claws.
entries.pt:
▁Ela▁açoita com a▁cauda para▁bater
Derruba o seu▁inimigo, e▁depois▁rasga▁os▁caídos.
▁oponente com▁garras▁afiadas.

entries.en:
Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to
an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out
fire at very high temperatures.

When it retracts its long neck into its
shell, it squirts out water with vigorous
force.
entries.pt:
▁Quando retrai o seu▁longo▁pescoço para o seu
▁casca, esguicha▁água com▁vigorosa
▁força.

entries.en:
This POKéMON is very popular as a pet.
Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its
longevity.
entries.pt:
▁Isto. POKéMON é▁muito popular▁como um animal de▁estimação.
▁Sua▁cauda▁coberta de▁pêlo é um▁símbolo de▁sua
▁longevidade.

entries.en:
It crushes its foe under its heavy body
to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will
withdraw inside its shell.
entries.pt:
Esmaga o seu▁inimigo▁sob o seu▁corpo▁pesado
para▁causar desmaio. Em▁uma pitada,▁ele▁vai
▁Retirem-se para▁dentro da▁sua▁concha.

entries.en:
It is covered with a green skin. When it
grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself
with silk, and becomes a cocoon.
entries.pt:
▁Está▁coberto de▁uma▁pele▁verde.
▁cresce,▁derrama a▁pele,▁cobre-se
com seda, e▁torna-se um▁casulo.

entries.en:
Even though it is encased in a sturdy
shell, the body inside is tender.
It can't withstand a harsh attack.
entries.pt:
▁Mesmo que▁esteja envolto em um▁robusto
Shell, o▁corpo▁lá▁dentro é▁macio.
▁Não▁suporta um▁ataque▁severo.

entries.en:
The wings are protected by rain-repellent
dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly
about even in rain.

Often found in forests and grasslands.
It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two
inches on top of its head.
entries.pt:
▁Muitas▁vezes▁encontrados em▁florestas e prados.
▁Tem▁uma farpa▁afiada e▁tóxica de▁cerca de▁dois.
▁polegadas em▁cima da▁cabeça.

entries.en:
This POKéMON is in a temporary stage
while making its body. It is almost
completely unable to move on its own.

May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent
speeds, all the while stabbing with the
toxic stinger on its rear.
entries.pt:
▁Pode▁aparecer▁num enxame.
▁velocidade,▁todo o tempo apunhalando com o
▁ferrão▁tóxico na▁sua▁traseira.

entries.en:
Does not like to fight. It hides in
tall grass and so on, foraging for food
such as small bugs.
entries.pt:
▁Não▁gosta de▁lutar.
▁grama▁alta e▁assim por▁diante, forrageando para▁alimentos
▁como▁pequenos bugs.

entries.en:
The claws on its feet are well developed.
It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE
to its nest over 60 miles away.
entries.pt:
As▁garras▁nos▁pés▁estão▁bem▁desenvolvidas.
▁Pode▁transportar▁presas▁como▁uma EXEGGCUTE
para o seu▁ninho a▁mais de 60▁milhas de▁distância.

entries.en:
It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to
intimidate enemies. It races through the
skies at Mach-2 speed.

Its fangs are long and very sharp.
They grow continuously, so it gnaws on
hard things to whittle them down.
entries.pt:
▁Suas▁presas são▁longas e▁muito▁afiadas.
▁Crescem▁continuamente, por▁isso roem
▁Coisas▁difíceis de aleijá-los.

entries.en:
Its rear feet have three toes each.
They are webbed, enabling it to swim
across rivers.

It busily flits around here and there.
Even if it is frail, it can be a tough
foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.
entries.pt:
▁Anda▁ocupado por▁aqui e por▁ali.
▁Mesmo que▁seja▁frágil,▁pode ser▁difícil.
▁inimigo que▁usa MIRROR MOVE.

entries.en:
Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it
aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a
whole day without landing.

A very common sight in grassland, etc.
It flicks its tongue in and out to sense
danger in its surroundings.
entries.pt:
▁Uma▁visão▁muito▁comum em▁campos, etc.
▁Ela▁mexe a▁língua para▁dentro e para▁fora para▁sentir
▁perigo▁nos▁seus▁arredores.

entries.en:
The pattern on its belly appears to be a
frightening face. Weak foes will flee just
at the sight of the pattern.
entries.pt:
O▁padrão em▁sua▁barriga▁parece ser um
▁rosto▁assustador. Fracos▁inimigos▁vão▁fugir▁apenas
à▁vista do▁padrão.

entries.en:
It has small electric sacs on both its
cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric
charges from the sacs.

Its electric charges can reach even
100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause
even an Indian elephant to faint.

It burrows and lives underground.
If threatened, it curls itself up into a
ball for protection.
entries.pt:
▁Ele▁escava e▁vive no▁subsolo.
Se▁ameaçado,▁ele se▁enrola em um
▁bola para▁proteção.

entries.en:
It is adept at attacking with the spines

It flies so silently through the dark on

It is not yet skilled at storing

The shell seems to be filled with joy.
It is said that it will share good luck
when treated kindly.

They say that it will appear before

Because its wings aren't yet fully grown,

▁Porque as▁suas▁asas▁ainda▁não▁estão▁completamente▁crescidas,

As a result of storing too much

It likes playing mischievous tricks such as

Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on

It has superb accuracy. The water it

It carries food all day long. There are

entries.en:

tell you about status problems!\pStatus problems include poisoning,
paralysis, sleep, burn…\pThere are a couple others, but

entries.en:
Does everyone know about type
matchups?\pPOKéMON and their moves all
belong to certain types.\pFor example, there are such types
as GRASS and WATER.\pYou need to consider the type of
the move used to attack…\pAnd, the type of the POKéMON that
is hit by that attack.\pDepending on how those two types
match up, the damage can change.\pYou see, it depends on whether
the type matchup is good or bad.\pIf you don't know how matchups
work, battles will be tough.\pSo, let me demonstrate exactly
what I mean.\pAll righty, here goes!\pKeep your eyes glued to the super
POKé DUDE SHOW!

Try moving on to a new road, town, or
place.

Any item that you are given by another
character goes in your BAG.\lThe item is automatically sorted and\lplaced in one of three pockets.\lFor instructions on the BAG's use,\lplease refer to the HELP System's\l“How do I do this?” heading.

entries.en:
If POKéMON are hurt in battle,
take them to a POKéMON CENTER and\lhave them healed by the staff.\lGet in the habit of saving your\lgame and recording your progress.\lStock up on healing items at\lPOKéMON MARTS before traveling far.

entries.en:
Forests are basically the same as
roads but they can be like mazes.\lAll forests have a way out, so don't\lgive up if you get lost.

entries.en:
Caves are dark and dangerous. Wild
POKéMON can appear anywhere in them.\lIf there is an emergency, rush to a\lPOKéMON CENTER or use items.\lNew towns await discovery beyond some\lcaves, so don't give up.

As▁cavernas são▁escuras e▁perigosas.

entries.en:
The object of the game is to train
your POKéMON and move forward.\lYou must collect info and solve\lproblems. For example, what do you\lneed to get around an obstacle?\lWhat would get that impeding\lperson out of the way?
entries.pt:
O▁objetivo do▁jogo é▁treinar
a▁sua POKéMON e▁seguir em▁frente.\l▁Você▁deve▁coletar▁informações e▁resolver\l▁problemas. Por▁exemplo, o que▁você\l▁Precisa de▁contornar um▁obstáculo?\lO que▁faria com que▁isso▁impedisse\lA▁pessoa▁está▁fora do▁caminho?

entries.en:
There are several kinds of items.
Some can be used only on the field.\lSome are only for use during battle.\lSome can be used anytime.\lTry using an item - if it can't be used,\lyou will be alerted.
entries.pt:
▁Existem▁vários▁tipos de▁itens.
▁Alguns▁só▁podem ser▁usados no▁campo.\l▁Alguns são▁apenas para▁uso▁durante a▁batalha.\l▁Alguns▁podem ser▁usados a▁qualquer▁momento.\l▁Tente▁usar um item - se▁não▁puder ser▁usado,\l▁Você▁será▁alertado.

entries.en:
In a battle, POKéMON try to reduce
one another's vitality, expressed as\lHP. If a POKéMON's HP falls to zero,\lit faints, and the other POKéMON\lwins. By winning a battle, POKéMON\learn EXP. Points, which help them\llevel up (grow stronger).

entries.en:
First, fully heal the POKéMON in your
party (the POKéMON with you) at any\lPOKéMON CENTER.\lYou should also buy healing items for\lemergencies at a POKéMON MART.

entries.en:
A POKéMON's vitality is expressed in HP.
If a POKéMON is hurt in battle, HP is\lsubtracted. If its HP drops to zero,\lthe POKéMON faints.\lHeal hurt or fainted POKéMON at a\lPOKéMON CENTER or by using items.

Se a POKéMON é▁ferido em▁batalha, HP é\lsubtraído. Se a▁sua HP▁cair para zero,\la POKéMON Desmaios.\l▁Cura▁ferida ou▁desmaiada POKéMON em▁uma\lPOKéMON CENTER ou▁usando▁itens.

entries.en:
A POKéMON CENTER is like an inn for
POKéMON. It will fully heal POKéMON of\lany status problems and fully restore\ltheir HP using a special machine.\lThis service is free, so get in the\lhabit of healing your POKéMON often.
entries.pt:
A POKéMON CENTER é▁como▁uma▁pousada para
POKéMON▁Ele▁vai▁curar▁completamente. POKéMON de\l▁quaisquer▁problemas de status e▁restaurar▁completamente\lA▁sua HP▁usando▁uma▁máquina▁especial.\lEste▁serviço é▁gratuito, por▁isso entre no\l▁hábito de▁curar a▁sua POKéMON ▁muitas▁vezes.

entries.en:
A status problem refers to an ailment
that is inflicted on a POKéMON by its\lfoe's attack. These include burns,\lparalysis, poisoning, sleep, and\lfreezing. These can be healed by\lvisiting a POKéMON CENTER or using\lthe appropriate item.
entries.pt:
Um▁problema de status▁refere-se a▁uma▁doença
que é▁infligido a um POKéMON ▁pela▁sua\l▁ataque do▁inimigo.▁Estes▁incluem▁queimaduras,\l▁paralisia,▁envenenamento,▁sono, e\l▁congelação.▁Estes▁podem ser▁curados por\l▁visitando▁uma POKéMON CENTRO ou▁utilização\lo item▁adequado.

entries.en:
If all the POKéMON in your party
(all the POKéMON with you) faint, you\llose some MONEY, and you are\lreturned home or to a POKéMON\lCENTER. To reduce that chance, visit\lPOKéMON CENTERS often. Also, get\lin the habit of saving often.
entries.pt:
Se▁todos▁os POKéMON no seu▁partido
(todas as POKéMON Contigo)▁desmaiar, tu\l▁perder▁algum▁dinheiro, e▁você é\l▁voltou para casa ou para um POKéMON\lCENTER. Para▁reduzir▁essa▁oportunidade,▁visite\lCENTROS POKÉMON com▁frequência.\lno▁hábito de▁salvar▁muitas▁vezes.

entries.en:
If a wild POKéMON escapes from a POKé
BALL, it's obviously still feisty.\lTry reducing its HP some more, and\ltry to weaken it with paralysis or sleep\lbefore trying to catch it.\lIf the POKé BALL rocks for a while,\lthe quarry is close to being caught!
entries.pt:
Se um▁selvagem POKéMON ▁escapa de um POKé
Ball, é▁óbvio que▁ainda é▁violento.\l▁Tente▁reduzir▁sua HP um▁pouco▁mais, e\l▁Tente enfraquecê-lo com▁paralisia ou▁sono\l▁Antes de▁tentar▁apanhá-lo.\lSe o POKé BALL▁balançar por um tempo,\lA pedreira▁está▁perto de ser▁apanhada!

entries.en:
There are shops, known as POKéMON
MARTS, that sell items.\lYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\lroads, in forests, or in caves.\lStock up on needed items while you are\lvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.

▁Há▁lojas,▁conhecidas▁como POKéMON
MARTS, que▁vendem▁artigos.\l▁Você▁não▁vai▁encontrar POKéMON MARTAS em▁curso\l▁estradas, em▁florestas, ou em▁cavernas.\lAcumule▁os▁itens▁necessários▁enquanto▁estiver\l▁visitando▁uma▁cidade com um POKéMON MART.

You may buy POKé BALLS at any
POKéMON MART in any town.\lYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\lroads, in forests, or in caves.\lStock up on POKé BALLS while you are\lvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.

entries.en:
A TRAINER is a person who raises
POKéMON through battling.\lTRAINERS will challenge you \lwherever they are - it could be on\la road, in forests, caves, anywhere.\lIf your eyes meet, you have to accept\ltheir challenge. So be careful!
entries.pt:
▁UM TRAINER é▁uma▁pessoa que▁cria
POKéMON ▁através da▁luta.\lTRAiners▁vão te▁desafiar \l▁onde▁quer que▁estejam -▁pode▁estar em\l▁uma▁estrada, em▁florestas,▁cavernas, em▁qualquer▁lugar.\lSe▁os▁teus▁olhos se▁encontram,▁tens de▁aceitar.\lO▁desafio▁deles.▁Portanto,▁tenha▁cuidado!

entries.en:
To beat a TRAINER in battle, use
POKéMON that have type advantages\lover the foe's POKéMON. You may also\luse highly trained POKéMON with\loverwhelming power. Outnumbering the\lfoe's POKéMON is another obvious\ltactic.

Para▁vencer um TRAiner em▁batalha, use

entries.en:
Wild POKéMON will appear in tall grass,
on roads, and in forests. They will\lappear anywhere in dark caves.\lThere are no wild POKéMON or TRAINERS\lin towns, so they are safe places.
entries.pt:
Selvagem POKéMON ▁aparecerão em▁relva▁alta,
▁nas▁estradas e▁nas▁florestas.\l▁aparecer em▁qualquer▁lugar em▁cavernas▁escuras.\l▁Não▁há▁selvagens. POKéMON ▁FORMADORES\lNas▁cidades, por▁isso, são▁lugares▁seguros.

entries.en:
POKéMON may learn up to four different
techniques, or moves. There is a great\lvariety of moves including attacks and\lthose with special effects. The kinds\lof moves that can be learned vary\lfor each POKéMON. Some moves\lcan be learned from machines.
entries.pt:
POKéMON ▁pode▁aprender▁até▁quatro▁diferentes
▁técnicas, ou▁movimentos.▁Há um grande\l▁variedade de▁movimentos,▁incluindo▁ataques e\l▁aqueles com▁efeitos▁especiais.▁Os▁tipos\lde▁movimentos que▁podem ser▁aprendidos▁variam\lpara▁cada POKéMON.▁Alguns▁movimentos\l▁pode ser▁aprendido com▁máquinas.

entries.en:
HIDDEN moves are those that are
especially important for your\ladventure. To use such a move outside\lof battle, open the “POKéMON” MENU\land make the POKéMON that knows the\lmove use it. A fainted POKéMON may use\la HIDDEN move outside of battle.
entries.pt:
▁Os▁movimentos▁ocultos são▁aqueles que são
▁especialmente▁importante para o seu\l▁aventura. Para▁usar▁tal▁movimento▁fora\lde▁batalha,▁abrir o “POKéMON“ MENU\le▁fazer o POKéMON que▁sabe o\lse▁mover use-o. Um desmaio POKéMON ▁pode▁utilizar\lum▁movimento▁escondido▁fora da▁batalha.

entries.en:
Select “FIGHT,” and the MENU of moves
will appear. Consider the type\lmatchups, and use the most effective\lmoves. You can check the effects of\lmoves by opening “POKéMON,”\lpicking a POKéMON, opening “SUMMARY,”\lthen opening “POKéMON SKILLS.”

▁Selecione “LUTA”, e o MENU de▁movimentos

entries.en:
The most a POKéMON can learn is four
moves. They are learned as the\lPOKéMON levels up. It can also be\ltaught a move using a TM (Technical\lMachine) or HM (Hidden Machine).\lThere are also people who teach moves.
entries.pt:
O▁mais um POKéMON ▁pode▁aprender é▁quatro
▁movimentos.▁Eles são▁aprendidos▁como o\l▁Níveis de POKéMON para▁cima.\l▁ensinou um▁movimento▁usando um▁TM (Tecnológico\l▁Máquina) ou HM (máquina▁escondida).\l▁Há▁também▁pessoas que▁ensinam▁movimentos.

entries.en:
The key to making your POKéMON
strong is to battle and win often.\lThe EXP. (Experience) Points earned\lby winning battles accumulate to\llevel up POKéMON that participated in\lthem. Battle wild POKéMON often to\llevel up your party.
entries.pt:
A▁chave para▁fazer o seu POKéMON
▁forte é▁lutar e▁vencer com▁frequência.\l▁Os▁pontos EXP. (Experiência)▁ganhos\l▁Ganhando▁batalhas▁acumular para\l▁nível de▁subida POKéMON que▁participou em\l▁Eles.▁Batalha▁selvagem POKéMON ▁frequentemente a\lAplaudam a▁vossa▁festa.

entries.en:
If your foes are too strong, try
leveling up your POKéMON some more.\lGo back the way you came and battle\lwild POKéMON to level up your party.\lYou may also battle TRAINERS whom you\lhave not battled before.
entries.pt:
Se▁os▁teus▁inimigos são▁demasiado▁fortes,▁tenta
▁nivelando seu POKéMON ▁Mais um▁pouco.\l▁Volta para o▁caminho por▁onde▁vieste e▁luta\l▁selvagem POKéMON Para▁nivelar a▁tua▁festa.\l▁Você▁também▁pode▁lutar contra▁os TRAINERS a▁quem▁você\l▁Nunca▁lutaram▁antes.

entries.en:
Unlike roads and forests, wild POKéMON
can appear anywhere in caves.\lIf your POKéMON are hurt in a cave,\lrush to a POKéMON CENTER or use items\lto heal them right away. It is very\ldangerous to force your luck in caves.
entries.pt:
▁Ao▁contrário de▁estradas e▁florestas,▁selvagens POKéMON
▁pode▁aparecer em▁qualquer▁lugar em▁cavernas.\lSe a▁sua POKéMON ▁estão▁feridos▁numa▁caverna,\l▁correr para um POKéMON CENTER ou▁itens de▁uso\lpara curá-los▁imediatamente.\l▁perigoso para▁forçar a▁sua▁sorte em▁cavernas.

entries.en:
Trust your own knowledge and power.
Believe in yourself and find your way!
entries.pt:
▁Confie em seu▁próprio▁conhecimento e▁poder.
▁Acredita em ti e▁encontra o▁teu▁caminho!

entries.en:
A POKéMON CENTER is identified by its
red roof and a “P.C” sign. Every\lPOKéMON CENTER offers such services as\lfully healing POKéMON and free PC use,\lmaking it essential for your travels.\lOn the upper floor are facilities for\llinking with friends and others.

A POKéMON O CENTER é▁identificado▁pela▁sua
▁telhado▁vermelho e um▁sinal “P.C”.\lPOKéMON CENTER▁oferece▁serviços▁como\l▁completamente▁cicatrizante POKéMON e▁utilização▁gratuita do PC,\l▁tornando-o▁essencial para as▁suas▁viagens.\lNo▁andar superior▁estão▁instalações para\l▁ligação com▁amigos e▁outros.

entries.en:
A POKéMON MART is identified by its
blue roof and a “MART” sign.\lItems can be bought and sold at any\lPOKéMON MART. Some MARTS carry items\lthat are available only in their towns.

A POKéMON O MART é▁identificado▁pela▁sua
▁telhado▁azul e um▁sinal “MART”.\lItens▁podem ser▁comprados e▁vendidos em▁qualquer\lPOKéMON MART.▁Alguns MARTS▁carregam▁itens\lque▁só▁estão▁disponíveis▁nas▁suas▁cidades.

entries.en:
You can safely end your game by
selecting “SAVE” on the MENU.\lOnce you have saved, the game can be\lsafely turned off. When the game is\lturned back on, you can resume from\lwhere you last saved.
entries.pt:

Seleccionar “SAVE” no MENU.\l▁Uma▁vez▁salvo, o▁jogo▁pode ser\l▁desligado com▁segurança.▁Quando o▁jogo é\l▁ligado de▁novo,▁você▁pode▁retomar de\l▁onde▁você▁salvou▁pela▁última▁vez.

entries.en:
POKéMON are living beings about which
many mysteries still remain. You may\lsee them in grass, the sea, and caves.\lThey appear to obey the wishes of the\lTRAINERS that caught them.
entries.pt:
POKéMON são▁seres▁vivos sobre▁os▁quais
▁muitos▁mistérios▁ainda▁permanecem.\l▁vê-os na▁relva, no mar e▁nas▁cavernas.\l▁Parecem▁obedecer▁aos▁desejos do\l▁Os▁treinadores que▁os▁apanharam.

entries.en:
Use the FAME CHECKER among the
KEY ITEMS in your BAG.\lIt may give you a hint, so try it out.

Use o FAME CHECKER entre▁os
PONTOS-CHAVE NO▁SEU BAG.\l▁Pode▁dar-te▁uma▁pista, por▁isso▁experimenta.

entries.en:
A HIDDEN move is taught to a POKéMON
using an HM (Hidden Machine).\lA HIDDEN move is important for helping\lyour adventure. For example, one is\lused to light up dark caves. Another\lcuts down small trees. There is one\lfor traveling on water, and so on.

▁Uma▁jogada HIDDEN é▁ensinada a um POKéMON

entries.en:
Try to catch wild POKéMON by throwing
the special SAFARI BALLS.\lYou may keep any item you find, too.

Your SAFARI GAME ends once you have
traveled a certain distance or thrown\lall your SAFARI BALLS.\lOpen the MENU to check the remaining\lnumber of steps and SAFARI BALLS.

entries.en:
If you would like to cut your SAFARI
GAME short, open the MENU and select\l“RETIRE” at the top of the list.

▁Jogo▁curto,▁abra o MENU e▁selecione\l“RETIRE” no▁topo da▁lista.

entries.en:
POKéMON GYMS are operated by the
POKéMON LEAGUE and are training\lfacilities for TRAINERS. They are all\lacross the land in cities and towns.\lEach one is headed by a LEADER, who\lis a very skilled TRAINER. Beat the\lLEADER to collect a BADGE.

{CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéDEX” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Choose POKéMON using commands such
   as “POKéMON LIST,”
   “HABITATS OF POKéMON,” and
   “SEARCH.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select a POKéMON to obtain detailed
   information.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione “POKéDEX” no MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Escolher POKéMON ▁usando▁comandos▁como
   “▁como “POKéMON ▁LISTA,
   “HABITATOS DE POKéMON, e
   “SARCH.”
{CIRCLE_3} Seleccionar um POKéMON para▁obter▁detalhes
   ▁Informação.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéMON” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Choose a POKéMON in your party.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “SUMMARY,” “SWITCH,”
   or “ITEM.”
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecionar “POKéMON” na MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Escolher um POKéMON Na▁tua▁festa.
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Selecione “SUMÁRIO”, “SWITCH,”
   ou “TEM”.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “SUMMARY.”
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the information:
   “POKéMON INFO”
   “POKéMON SKILLS”
   “KNOWN MOVES”
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione "SUMÁRIO".
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Pressione à▁esquerda ou à▁direita na {PLUS} ▁Controlo
   Pad para▁verificar as▁informações:
   “POKéMON ▁INFO»
   “POKéMON PEIXES”
   “MULTAS DE CONHECIMENTO”

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Choose the POKéMON you want to
   switch around.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “SWITCH.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select the POKéMON to switch with
   the first one.
The POKéMON at the left of the screen
will be the first one out in a battle.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Escolha o POKéMON ▁você▁quer
   Mudem de▁direcção.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecione “SWITCH.”
{CIRCLE_3} Seleccionar o POKéMON para▁alternar com
   O primeiro.
A POKéMON à▁esquerda do▁ecrã
▁será o primeiro a▁sair▁numa▁batalha.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select whether you want to “GIVE”
   an item to the POKéMON to hold,
   or “TAKE” an item it is holding.
A POKéMON can hold no more than one
item!
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione “TEM”.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecione se▁você▁deseja “GIVE”
   um item para o POKéMON para▁manter,
   ou “PAGAR” um item que▁detém.
A POKéMON ▁não▁pode▁segurar▁mais de um
item!

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “BAG” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to check the data headings:
   “ITEMS”
   “KEY ITEMS”
   “POKé BALLS”
   Press up or down to select an item.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione “BAG” na MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Pressione à▁esquerda ou à▁direita na {PLUS} ▁Controlo
   Pad para▁verificar▁os▁títulos de▁dados:
   “ITES”
   “PONTOS DE CAUSALIDADE”
   “POKÉ BALLS”
   ▁Pressione para▁cima ou para▁baixo para▁selecionar um item.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select the “ITEMS” POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select an item.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to use the selected
   item.
Some items may not be used depending
on the place and/or situation.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione o “ITEMS” POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Pressione para▁cima ou para▁baixo sobre o {PLUS} ▁Controlo
   Pad para▁selecionar um item.
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Selecione "USE" para▁usar o▁selecionado
   item.
▁Alguns▁itens▁podem▁não ser▁usados▁dependendo
sobre o local e/ou▁situação.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select a key item.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to use the selected
   key item.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione o POCKET “ITEM DE QUINHO”.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Pressione para▁cima ou para▁baixo sobre o {PLUS} ▁Controlo
   Pad para▁selecionar um item▁chave.
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Selecione "USE" para▁usar o▁selecionado
   item-chave.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} While battling a wild POKéMON,
   select the BAG's “POKé BALLS”
   POCKET.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select a POKé BALL.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to throw the selected
   POKé BALL.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Enquanto▁lutava contra um▁selvagem POKéMON,
   ▁selecione “POKé BALLS” do BAG
   Bolsinha.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Pressione para▁cima ou para▁baixo sobre o {PLUS} ▁Controlo
   Pad para▁selecionar um POKé Ball.
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Selecione "USE" para▁lançar o▁selecionado
   Poké Ball.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Your TRAINER CARD is displayed face
   up with basic information. Press the
   A Button to turn the CARD over.
{CIRCLE_3} A variety of data can be found on
   the reverse side of the CARD.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecionar “{PLAYER}” na MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Seu CARTÃO DE▁FORMAÇÃO é▁exibido face
   ▁até com▁informações▁básicas.▁Pressione o
   Um▁botão para▁virar o▁cartão.
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Uma▁variedade de▁dados▁pode ser▁encontrada em
   o▁lado▁inverso do CARD.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “SAVE” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “YES” and your progress is
   recorded in the save file.
Once the game is saved, you may turn
off the game. Your game can be resumed
from where you saved.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione “SAVE” no MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecione "SIM" e seu▁progresso é
   ▁gravado no▁arquivo de▁gravação.
▁Uma▁vez que o▁jogo é▁salvo,▁você▁pode▁virar
▁fora do▁jogo.▁Seu▁jogo▁pode ser▁retomado
De▁onde▁você▁salvou.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “OPTION” on the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad to select an optional item, then
   press left or right to alter the
   settings.
{CIRCLE_3} Select “CANCEL” or press the
   B Button after making changes.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione “OPÇÃO” no MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Pressione para▁cima ou para▁baixo sobre o {PLUS} ▁Controlo
   Pad para▁selecionar um item▁opcional,▁então
   ▁pressione▁esquerda ou▁direita para▁alterar o
   ▁configurações.
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Selecione “CANCEL” ou▁pressione o
   Botão B▁após▁fazer▁alterações.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad and select “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select “POTION” in the “ITEMS”
   POCKET.
{CIRCLE_4} Select “USE.”
{CIRCLE_5} Select the POKéMON to be healed.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Abra a MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Pressione para▁cima ou para▁baixo sobre o {PLUS} ▁Controlo
   Pad e▁selecione “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Selecione “POÇÃO” no “ITEMS”
   Bolsinha.
{CIRCLE_4} ▁Selecione “USE.”
{CIRCLE_5} Seleccionar o POKéMON para ser▁curado.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control
   Pad and select “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} Press left or right to open the
   “KEY ITEMS” POCKET, then press
   up or down to select “TOWN MAP.” 
{CIRCLE_4} Select “USE” to open the TOWN MAP.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Abra a MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Pressione para▁cima ou para▁baixo sobre o {PLUS} ▁Controlo
   Pad e▁selecione “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Pressione▁esquerda ou▁direita para▁abrir o
   POCKET “ITEM DE CHAVE” e, em▁seguida,▁pressione
   para▁cima ou para▁baixo para▁selecionar “TOWN MAP.” 
{CIRCLE_4} ▁Selecione "USE" para▁abrir o MAPA DA CIDADE.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the
   “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” the TM CASE.
{CIRCLE_4} Select and “USE” a TM.
{CIRCLE_5} Select a POKéMON that can learn the
   move in the TM.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Abra a MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Abra o POCKET “ITEM DE QUINHO” no
   “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” o▁TM CASO.
{CIRCLE_4} ▁Selecione e “USE” um▁TM.
{CIRCLE_5} Seleccionar um POKéMON que▁pode▁aprender o
   Movam-se na MT.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the
   “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” the TM CASE.
{CIRCLE_4} Select and “USE” an HM.
{CIRCLE_5} Select a POKéMON that can learn it.
HMs are hard to remove, so be careful!
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Abra a MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Abra o POCKET “ITEM DE QUINHO” no
   “BAG.”
{CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” o▁TM CASO.
{CIRCLE_4} ▁Selecione e “USE” um HM.
{CIRCLE_5} Seleccionar um POKéMON que▁pode▁aprender.
HMs são▁difíceis de▁remover,▁então▁tenha▁cuidado!

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “POKéMON.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select a POKéMON that knows an
   HM move. The usable HM move(s)
   will be shown in blue. Select and
   use the desired move to destroy an
   obstacle, fly, surf, etc.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Abra a MENU.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecionar “POKéMON.”
{CIRCLE_3} Seleccionar um POKéMON que▁conhece um
   ▁Movimento HM. O( s)▁movimento( s) HM▁utilizável( s)
   ▁será▁mostrado em▁azul.▁Selecione e
   ▁usar o▁movimento▁desejado para▁destruir um
   ▁obstáculo,▁mosca, surf, etc.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU. Open the
   “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the “BAG”
   and select the “BICYCLE.”
{CIRCLE_2} The BICYCLE can be ridden by
   selecting “USE.” You may also
   “REGISTER” it for instant use by
   pressing SELECT.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Abra o MENU.▁Abra o
   POCKET “INCLUÍDOS DE CAPITAL” no “BAG”
   e▁selecione o “BICÍCIO”.
{CIRCLE_2} O BICICLE▁pode ser▁montado por
   seleccionando “USE.”▁Você▁também▁pode
   “REGISTER” para▁utilização▁instantânea por
   ▁pressionando SELECT.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Move the cursor to the letter you
   want with the {PLUS} Control Pad, then
   press the A Button to enter it.
{CIRCLE_2} Press the B Button to back up.
{CIRCLE_3} Press SELECT to switch between
   uppercase and lowercase letters.
{CIRCLE_4} Press the A Button on “OK.”
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Mover o▁cursor para a▁letra que▁você
   ▁quer com o {PLUS} Controlar o Pad,▁então.
   ▁pressione o▁botão A para digitá-lo.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Pressione o▁botão B para▁fazer backup.
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Pressione SELECT para▁alternar entre
   ▁letras▁maiúsculas e▁minúsculas.
{CIRCLE_4} ▁Pressione o▁botão A em “OK.”

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Go to any POKéMON CENTER, go up
   to the PC, then press the A Button.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Ir para▁qualquer POKéMON CENTER,▁sobe.
   para o PC,▁então▁pressione o▁botão A.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{STR_VAR_1}'S PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select from one of the top three
   MENU items to access the POKéMON
   Storage System.
If you catch a POKéMON when you have
six in your party, the POKéMON is sent
automatically to a BOX in the System!
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecionar “{STR_VAR_1}'S PC' no PC.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecione entre um▁dos▁três▁primeiros
   Itens MENU para▁acessar o POKéMON
   Sistema de▁armazenamento.
Se▁apanhares▁uma POKéMON ▁quando▁tem
▁seis no seu▁partido, o POKéMON é▁enviado
▁automaticamente para▁uma BOX no Sistema!

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in the open BOX
   with the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “WITHDRAW” to remove the
   POKéMON from the BOX and add it to
   your party.
You may not withdraw a POKéMON if you
already have six POKéMON with you!
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} Seleccionar um POKéMON na CAIXA▁aberta
   com a {PLUS} Controla a▁plataforma.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecionar “WITHDRAW” para▁remover o
   POKéMON da CAIXA e adicioná- la a
   A▁tua▁festa.
▁Não▁pode▁retirar▁uma POKéMON e▁você
▁já▁tem▁seis POKéMON Contigo!

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in your party with
   the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “DEPOSIT.”
{CIRCLE_3} Select the BOX, then press the
   A Button to store the POKéMON.
If you have only one POKéMON with you,
it may not be stored!
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} Seleccionar um POKéMON na▁sua▁festa com
   a {PLUS} Controla a▁plataforma.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecione "DEPOSITAR".
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Selecione o BOX e▁pressione o
   Um▁botão para▁armazenar o POKéMON.
Se▁você▁tem▁apenas um POKéMON Contigo,
▁não▁pode ser▁armazenado!

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in the open BOX.
{CIRCLE_2} Pick up the POKéMON by selecting
   “MOVE” and move it anywhere with
   the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_3} Move the POKéMON to the BOX name
   and press left or right to move it
   to another BOX.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} Seleccionar um POKéMON na▁caixa▁aberta.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Apanhar o POKéMON ▁selecionando
   “MOVER” e movê-lo em▁qualquer▁lugar com
   a {PLUS} Controla a▁plataforma.
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Mover o POKéMON para o▁nome CAX
   e▁pressione▁esquerda ou▁direita para movê-lo
   para▁outra CAX.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Faintly shown POKéMON can be made
   to hold an item by selecting it and
   pressing the A Button.
{CIRCLE_2} Clearly shown POKéMON can be made
   to give the item they are holding to
   another POKéMON, or return the item
   to the BAG with the A Button.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} De▁forma▁fraca POKéMON ▁pode ser▁feito
   para▁manter um item▁selecionando-o e
   ▁pressionando o▁botão A.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Mostrado▁claramente POKéMON ▁pode ser▁feito
   para▁dar o item que▁eles▁estão▁segurando
   ▁outro POKéMON, ou▁devolver o item
   para o BAG com o▁botão A.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}'s PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select either “ITEM STORAGE” or
   “MAILBOX.”
You may store things in your own PC
if your BAG is full. You may also
withdraw items stored in your PC.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecionar “{PLAYER}'s PC' no PC.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecione “ARMAZENAMENTO DE ITEM” ou
   “MAILBOX.”
▁Você▁pode▁armazenar▁coisas em seu▁próprio PC
Se o seu BAG▁estiver▁cheio.
▁retirar▁os▁itens▁armazenados no seu PC.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item to be withdrawn.
{CIRCLE_3} The item can be withdrawn and
   placed in the BAG's ITEMS POCKET.
   It may also be directly given to a
   POKéMON to hold.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecionar “WITHDRAW PONTOS DE RISCO.”
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecione o item a ser▁retirado.
{CIRCLE_3} O▁ponto▁pode ser▁retirado e
   ▁Colocado no PÓ DE PONTOS do BAG.
   ▁Pode▁também ser▁directamente▁administrado a
   POKéMON ▁Esperar.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the item in the BAG to be
   deposited using the {PLUS} Control Pad.
{CIRCLE_3} If there is more than one 
   item to be deposited, enter the
   quantity with the {PLUS} Control Pad,
   then press the A Button.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione “DEPÓSITO”.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecione o item no BAG a ser
   ▁depositada▁utilizando a {PLUS} Controla a▁plataforma.
{CIRCLE_3} Se▁houver▁mais de um 
   ▁Artigo a▁depositar,▁indicar o
   ▁quantidade com a {PLUS} Control Pad,
   Em▁seguida,▁pressione o▁botão A.

entries.en:
When MAIL is taken from a POKéMON,
it is moved to the MAILBOX. If it has
no MAIL, the MAILBOX can't be used.
{CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}'S PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “MAILBOX” to read MAIL or
   make a POKéMON hold MAIL.
entries.pt:
▁Quando o MAIL é▁retirado de POKéMON,
é▁deslocado para o MAILBOX.
▁Não,▁não▁pode ser▁usado.
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecionar “{PLAYER}'S PC' no PC.
{CIRCLE_2} ▁Selecione “MAILBOX” para▁ler MAIL ou
   ▁fazer▁uma POKéMON ▁Não,▁não,▁não,▁não.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “PROF. OAK'S PC” on the PC.
{CIRCLE_2} PROF. OAK will evaluate your
   POKéDEX.
His evaluations should give you hints
for catching more POKéMON!
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecione “PROF. OAK'S PC' no PC.
{CIRCLE_2} PROF. OAK ▁avaliará a▁sua
   Pokédex.
As▁avaliações▁dele▁devem▁dar-te▁dicas.
para▁capturar▁mais POKéMON!

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Press START.
{CIRCLE_2} The MENU will open on the right.
{CIRCLE_3} Depending on the situation, the MENU
   may feature different headings.
The MENU will not open in certain
situations such as when talking, doing
something, battling, etc.
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Pressione Start.
{CIRCLE_2} O MENU▁vai▁abrir à▁direita.
{CIRCLE_3} ▁Dependendo da▁situação, a MENU
   ▁pode▁apresentar▁diferentes▁títulos.
A MENU▁não▁abrirá em▁certas▁condições.
▁situações▁como▁falar,▁fazer
▁alguma▁coisa,▁batalhas, etc.

entries.en:
{CIRCLE_1} Select “FIGHT.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select one of the moves shown,
and that move will be used!

{CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéMON.”
{CIRCLE_2} Select the POKéMON in your party
   that you want to use.
{CIRCLE_3} If you have two or more POKéMON
   with you, they may be switched by
   selecting “SHIFT.” Check POKéMON
   data by selecting “SUMMARY.”
entries.pt:
{CIRCLE_1} ▁Selecionar “POKéMON.”
{CIRCLE_2} Seleccionar o POKéMON no seu▁partido
   que▁você▁quer▁usar.
{CIRCLE_3} Se▁tiver▁dois ou▁mais POKéMON
   ▁contigo,▁eles▁podem ser▁trocados por
   seleccionando “SHIFT.”▁Verificar POKéMON
   ▁dados▁selecionando “SUMÁRIO”.

entries.en:
This command switches the POKéMON in
battle with another one in your party.
{CIRCLE_1} Select the POKéMON to be sent out.
{CIRCLE_2} Select “SHIFT.”
{CIRCLE_3} The selected POKéMON will switch
   places with the POKéMON in battle!
entries.pt:

HP indicates a POKéMON's vitality.
If a POKéMON's HP drops to zero, it\lfaints and is unable to battle.\lSo, the key in battle is to try to\lreduce the foe's HP to zero.\lIf your POKéMON are hurt, restore their\lHP at a POKéMON CENTER or use items.
entries.pt:
HP▁indica a POKéMONÉ a▁vitalidade.
Se a POKéMONA HP▁cai para zero.\lDesmaia e é▁incapaz de▁lutar.\l▁Então, a▁chave na▁batalha é▁tentar\l▁reduzir a HP do▁inimigo para zero.\lSe a▁sua POKéMON ▁estão▁magoados,▁restabeleçam a▁sua\lHP em▁uma POKéMON CENTER ou▁itens de▁uso.

entries.en:
EXP. Points stands for “Experience
Points.” POKéMON gain EXP. Points by\lparticipating in winning battles.\lWhen a POKéMON accumulates sufficient\lEXP. Points, it levels up. The EXP. Bar\lindicates accumulated EXP. Points.\lIt returns to zero upon leveling up.
entries.pt:
EXP.▁Pontos▁significa “Experiência
▁Pontos.” POKéMON ▁ganhar EXP.▁Pontos por\l▁participar em▁batalhas▁vencedoras.\l▁Quando a POKéMON ▁acumula-se▁suficiente\lEXP.▁Pontos,▁ele▁nivela. A▁barra de EXP.\l▁indica EXP▁acumulado.▁Pontos.\l▁Ele▁retorna▁ao zero▁ao▁nivelar.

entries.en:
POKéMON may learn up to four different
moves. There are many kinds of moves\lincluding attacks and those with\lspecial effects. The kinds of moves\lthat can be learned vary for each\lPOKéMON. Some moves can be learned\lfrom items.
entries.pt:
POKéMON ▁pode▁aprender▁até▁quatro▁diferentes
▁movimentos.▁Existem▁muitos▁tipos de▁movimentos\l▁incluindo▁ataques e▁aqueles com\l▁efeitos▁especiais.▁Os▁tipos de▁movimentos\lque▁podem ser▁aprendidos▁variam para▁cada\lPOKéMON.▁Alguns▁movimentos▁podem ser▁aprendidos\lde▁itens.

entries.en:
ATTACK indicates the power of an
offensive move. The higher this stat,\lthe more powerful the move.\lIt is applied for the following move\ltypes: NORMAL, POISON, GROUND,\lFLYING, BUG, FIGHTING, ROCK, GHOST,\land STEEL.
entries.pt:
ATTACK▁indica o▁poder de um
▁Quanto▁mais▁alto for esta▁taxa,\l▁Quanto▁mais▁poderoso for o▁movimento.\lÉ▁aplicado para o▁movimento▁seguinte\l▁Tipos: NORMAL, POISÃO, FUNDO,\lVoando,▁atirando,▁lutando, rock,▁fantasma,\le▁aço.

entries.en:
DEFENSE indicates the resistance a
POKéMON has against physical attacks.\lThe higher this stat, the less damage\lsustained from a foe's physical hit.
entries.pt:
DEFESA▁indica a▁resistência a
POKéMON ▁tem contra▁ataques▁físicos.\l▁Quanto▁mais▁alta esta▁estatística,▁menos▁danos\l▁sustentada▁pelo▁ataque▁físico de um▁inimigo.

entries.en:
SP. ATK (Special Attack) indicates the
power of a special attack move.\lThe higher this stat, the more powerful\lthe special attack move.\lIt is applied for the following move\ltypes: FIRE, WATER, ELECTRIC, GRASS,\lICE, PSYCHIC, DRAGON, and DARK.
entries.pt:
SP. ATK (Ataque▁Especial)▁indica o
▁poder de um▁ataque▁especial.\l▁Quanto▁mais▁alta esta▁estatística,▁mais▁poderoso\lO▁ataque▁especial.\lÉ▁aplicado para o▁movimento▁seguinte\l▁Tipos:▁Fogo,▁Água, Eléctrico, GRASS,\lICE, PSYCHIC,▁Dragon, e Dark.

entries.en:
SP. DEF (Special Defense) indicates
the resistance a POKéMON has against\lspecial attacks.\lThe higher this stat, the less damage\lsustained from a foe's special attack.
entries.pt:
SP. DEF (Defesa▁Especial)▁indica
a▁resistência a POKéMON ▁tem contra\l▁Ataques▁especiais.\l▁Quanto▁mais▁alta esta▁estatística,▁menos▁danos\l▁sustentados▁pelo▁ataque▁especial de um▁inimigo.

entries.en:
SPEED indicates the agility of a
POKéMON. If this stat exceeds the foe's\lin battle, the POKéMON can make a move\lbefore its slower opponent.
entries.pt:
VELOCIDADE▁indica a▁agilidade de▁uma
POKéMON. Se esta▁estatística▁exceder a do▁inimigo\lem▁batalha, o POKéMON ▁pode▁fazer▁uma▁jogada\l▁antes do seu▁adversário▁mais▁lento.

entries.en:
Lv. (Level) indicates the growth and
strength of a POKéMON.\lIn general, when a POKéMON levels up,\lits stats such as HP, ATTACK, and\lDEFENSE rise, making it stronger.\lPOKéMON may learn a new move upon\lleveling up.
entries.pt:
Lv. (Nível)▁indica o▁crescimento e
▁força de a POKéMON.\lEm▁geral,▁quando▁uma POKéMON ▁níveis para▁cima,\las▁suas▁estatísticas,▁tais▁como HP, ATTACK, e\lDefenda o▁aumento,▁tornando-o▁mais▁forte.\lPOKéMON▁pode▁aprender um▁novo▁passo em▁frente\lA▁nivelar.

entries.en:
POKéMON and moves are classified by
type. Every type has advantageous and\ldisadvantageous matchups against\lother types. For example, like a rock-\lpaper-scissors game, the WATER type is\lstrong against the FIRE type and weak\lagainst the GRASS type.
entries.pt:
POKéMON e▁movimentos são▁classificados por
▁tipo.▁Cada▁tipo▁tem▁vantagem e\ldesvantajosos▁confrontos contra\l▁outros▁tipos. Por▁exemplo,▁como▁uma▁rocha-\l▁papel-cissor▁jogo, o▁tipo de▁água é\l▁forte contra o▁tipo de▁fogo e▁fraco\lcontra o▁tipo GRASS.

entries.en:
OT stands for “Original TRAINER,”
the first TRAINER to have caught the\lselected POKéMON.\lEven if the POKéMON is traded, the OT\lname will remain unchanged.
entries.pt:
OT▁significa “Treinador Original”,
o primeiro TRAINER a ter▁apanhado o\l▁selecionado POKéMON.\l▁Mesmo que o POKéMON é▁negociado, o OT\lO▁nome▁permanecerá▁inalterado.

entries.en:
All POKéMON can be made to hold one
item each. Some items will be used by\lthe POKéMON automatically in certain\lsituations. To make a POKéMON hold an\litem, select the item from the BAG and\l“GIVE” it to the POKéMON.
entries.pt:
▁Tudo POKéMON ▁pode ser▁feito para▁segurar um
item▁cada.▁Alguns▁itens▁serão▁usados por\la POKéMON ▁automaticamente em▁certo\l▁situações. Para▁fazer▁uma POKéMON ▁manter▁uma\litem,▁selecione o item do BAG e\l“DÁ - lo”▁ao POKéMON.

entries.en:
All POKéMON have a special ABILITY.
There are many different kinds of these\labilities, some used in battle, some\lelsewhere. The abilities differ from\lspecies to species. Some species may\lhave more than one kind of ability.
entries.pt:
▁Tudo POKéMON ter▁uma▁capacidade▁especial.
▁Existem▁muitos▁tipos▁diferentes▁destes\l▁habilidades,▁alguns▁usados em▁batalha,▁alguns\l▁outras. As▁habilidades▁diferem de\l▁espécie para▁espécie.▁Algumas▁espécies▁podem\l▁têm▁mais de um▁tipo de▁habilidade.

entries.en:
Whenever you win a battle against a
TRAINER, you are given prize money.\lSave up your prize money so you can\lenjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!
entries.pt:
▁Sempre que▁você▁ganhar▁uma▁batalha contra um
TRAiner,▁você▁recebe o▁prêmio em▁dinheiro.\l▁Guarde o seu▁dinheiro para que▁possa\l▁desfrutar de▁compras em POKéMON Marts!

entries.en:
Moves are also classified by types.
If a POKéMON of a certain type uses\la move of the same type, the move's\lpower is boosted. If the move's type\lhas a matchup advantage against the\ltarget, its effectiveness is also\lboosted.
entries.pt:
▁Os▁movimentos▁também são▁classificados por▁tipos.
Se a POKéMON de um▁determinado▁tipo de▁utilização\lum▁movimento do▁mesmo▁tipo, o▁movimento\l▁energia é▁aumentada. Se o▁tipo de▁movimento\l▁tem▁uma▁vantagem matchup contra o\l▁objectivo, a▁sua▁eficácia é▁também\l▁Foi▁impulsionado.

entries.en:
All POKéMON have a personality,
or “NATURE.” The POKéMON's\lnature appears to affect how the\lPOKéMON will grow upon leveling up.
entries.pt:
▁Tudo POKéMON ter▁uma▁personalidade,
ou “NATUREZA”. POKéMON's\la▁natureza▁parece▁afectar a▁forma▁como o\lPOKéMON▁crescerá▁ao▁nivelar.

entries.en:
The ID No. is a special number assigned
specifically to you as a TRAINER.\lTogether with the OT name, the ID No.\lis used to precisely identify the\lOriginal TRAINER.\lThe ID No. does not change even if the\lPOKéMON is traded.
entries.pt:
O▁número de▁identificação é um▁número▁especial▁atribuído
▁especificamente para▁você▁como um TREINADOR.\l▁Juntamente com o▁nome OT, o▁número de▁identificação.\lé▁utilizado para▁identificar▁precisamente o\lTreinador original.\lO ID n.o▁não▁muda,▁mesmo que o\lO POKéMON é▁comercializado.

entries.en:
PP stands for “Power Points.”
It indicates the number of times a\lcertain move can be used in battle.\lLike HP, PP can be restored by visiting\la POKéMON CENTER or using certain\litems.
entries.pt:
PP▁significa “Pontos de▁Energia”.
▁Indica o▁número de▁vezes a\l▁certo▁movimento▁pode ser▁usado na▁batalha.\l▁Como HP, PP▁pode ser▁restaurado▁visitando\la POKéMON CENTRO ou▁utilização de▁certas▁substâncias\l▁itens.

entries.en:
POWER indicates the strength of an
attack. The higher this number, the\lgreater the damage that can be\linflicted on the foe!
entries.pt:
PODER▁indica a▁força de um
▁ataque.▁Quanto▁maior▁este▁número, o\l▁maior o▁dano que▁pode ser\l▁infligido▁ao▁inimigo!

entries.en:
ACCURACY indicates the probability of
the move hitting the foe.\lThe higher this number, the more likely\lthe move will strike the target.
entries.pt:
A ACTIVIDADE▁indica a▁probabilidade de
o▁movimento que▁atinge o▁inimigo.\l▁Quanto▁mais▁elevado for▁este▁número,▁mais▁provável▁será que\lO▁movimento▁atingirá o▁alvo.

entries.en:
FNT stands for “fainted.”
A POKéMON faints if its HP is reduced\lto zero. It becomes incapable of taking\lpart in battle.\lRestore a fainted POKéMON at a POKéMON\lCENTER, or use an item.

entries.en:
Ordinary items bought at any POKéMON
MART are placed in the ITEMS POCKET.\lItems may be used, given to a POKéMON\lto hold, or tossed out as garbage.

O MART é▁colocado no POCKET DE ITEMS.\l▁Os▁itens▁podem ser▁usados,▁dados a POKéMON\lpara▁segurar, ou▁jogado▁fora▁como▁lixo.

Important items that you find or 
receive from people are placed in the\lKEY ITEMS POCKET.\lKey items may be used, or registered\lfor use instantly with SELECT. Once\lregistered, the item can be used\lwithout opening the MENU and BAG.

▁receber de▁pessoas são▁colocados na\lPÓQUETE DE PONTOS-CHAVE\l▁Os▁pontos-chave▁podem ser▁utilizados ou▁registados\lpara▁usar instantaneamente com SELECT.\l▁registrado, o item▁pode ser▁usado\l▁sem▁abrir o MENU e o BAG.

catching wild POKéMON, are placed in\lthe POKé BALLS POCKET.\lPOKé BALLS may be bought at POKéMON\lMARTS. They may be used, given to a\lPOKéMON to hold, or tossed out as\lgarbage.

▁captura▁selvagem POKéMON, são▁colocados em\lO Poké Balls Pocket.\lPOKé BALLS▁podem ser▁comprados em POKéMON\lMARTS.▁Podem ser▁utilizados,▁dados a\lPOKéMON para▁segurar, ou▁jogado para▁fora▁como\lLixo.

entries.en:
A TM (Technical Machine) is a device
used to teach a move to a POKéMON.\lThere are many different kinds.\lMoves can be taught only to those\lPOKéMON capable of using them.\lA TM breaks after a single use.
entries.pt:
Um▁TM (máquina▁técnica) é um▁dispositivo
▁usado para▁ensinar um▁movimento para um POKéMON.\l▁Há▁muitos▁tipos▁diferentes.\l▁Os▁movimentos▁só▁podem ser▁ensinados▁àqueles\lPOKéMON▁capaz de▁os▁utilizar.\l▁Uma▁TM▁quebra▁após▁uma▁única▁utilização.

entries.en:
An HM (Hidden Machine) is a device used
to teach a HIDDEN move to a POKéMON.\lA HIDDEN move can be taught only to\lthose POKéMON capable of using it.\lUnlike a TM, an HM can be used over\land over. A HIDDEN move can be tough\lfor a POKéMON to forget.
entries.pt:
HM (Hidden Machine) é um▁dispositivo▁usado
para▁ensinar um HIDDEN▁mover-se para um POKéMON.\l▁UM▁movimento ODIENTE▁só▁pode ser▁ensinado a\l▁aqueles POKéMON ▁capaz de o▁utilizar.\l▁Ao▁contrário de um▁TM, um HM▁pode ser▁usado sobre\l▁Uma▁jogada▁escondida▁pode ser▁difícil.\lpara▁uma POKéMON ▁Esquecer.

entries.en:
Among POKéMON, there are some that
undergo major changes (evolution) upon\lgrowing to certain levels. Evolution\lcauses a POKéMON to alter form, change\lits name, and perhaps change the moves\lit may learn. Some POKéMON evolve\ldue to reasons other than leveling up.
entries.pt:
Entre POKéMON,▁há▁alguns que
▁sofrer▁grandes▁alterações (evolução)▁após\l▁Crescendo para▁certos▁níveis.▁Evolução\l▁causa a POKéMON para▁alterar a▁forma,▁alterar\lseu▁nome, e▁talvez▁mudar▁os▁movimentos\l▁talvez▁aprenda. POKéMON ▁evoluir\l▁devido a▁outras▁razões que▁não o▁nivelamento.

entries.en:
Status problems include:
Sleep: Can't use moves.\lPoison: Causes steady HP loss.\lParalysis: May prevent moves.\lBurn: HP loss and lowers ATTACK.\lFreeze: Can't use moves.\lThese can be healed with items, etc.
entries.pt:
▁Os▁problemas de▁estado▁incluem:
Sono:▁Não se▁pode▁usar▁movimentos.\lVeneno:▁Causa▁perda▁constante de HP.\lParalisia:▁Pode▁evitar▁movimentos.\l▁Queimadura: Perda de HP e▁diminui ATTACK.\lCongelar:▁Não se▁pode▁usar▁movimentos.\l▁Estes▁podem ser▁curados com▁itens, etc.

entries.en:
POKéMON is a name given to describe
wondrous creatures that inhabit all\lcorners of this world.\lPeople raise POKéMON to be their pets,\luse them for battling, and so on.
entries.pt:
POKéMON é um▁nome▁dado para▁descrever
▁criaturas▁maravilhosas que▁habitam▁todos\l▁cantos▁deste▁mundo.\lAs▁pessoas▁levantam POKéMON para▁serem▁seus▁animais de▁estimação,\l▁Usa-os para▁lutar, e▁assim por▁diante.

As▁mensagens de▁ajuda▁mudam▁dependendo de
▁quanto▁você▁progrediu na\l▁jogo.▁Eles são▁projetados para▁apoiá-lo\l▁quando▁você▁precisa▁deles. Se▁houver\l▁qualquer▁coisa que▁não▁compreendas,\lPor favor, procure o▁sistema de▁ajuda!

entries.en:
You become the main character to
explore the world of POKéMON!\lBy talking to people and solving\lmysteries, new paths will open to you.\lStrive for the goal together with your\lwonderful POKéMON!
entries.pt:
▁Você se▁torna o▁personagem principal para
▁explorar o▁mundo de POKéMON!\l▁Falando com as▁pessoas e resolvendo\l▁mistérios,▁novos▁caminhos se▁abrirão para▁você.\lEsforce-se para o▁objetivo▁junto com o seu\l▁maravilhoso POKéMON!

entries.en:
This game communicates over a wireless
link using the Wireless Adapter.\pGo wireless anywhere, anytime, and
with anybody!\pTry playing with the Wireless Adapter
always attached!
entries.pt:
Este▁jogo se▁comunica▁através de um wireless
link▁usando o▁adaptador▁sem▁fio.\p▁Ir▁sem▁fios em▁qualquer▁lugar, a▁qualquer▁momento, e
Com▁qualquer um!\p▁Tente▁jogar com o▁adaptador▁sem▁fio
▁Sempre apegado!

entries.en:
Visit every city and town, travel every
road, explore every cave, and face\levery challenge as you strive to\lbecome the greatest TRAINER of\lPOKéMON!
entries.pt:
▁Visite▁cada▁cidade e▁cidade, viaje▁cada
▁estrada,▁explorar▁cada▁caverna, e▁rosto\l▁cada▁desafio▁enquanto▁você se▁esforça para\l▁tornar-se o▁maior TREINADOR de\lPokémon!

entries.en:
On your adventure, you will be faced
with many obstacles. Every obstacle\lcan be overcome by doing something\lor by solving mysteries. Some obstacles\lare affected by something that happens\lfar away.

Some of the obstacles in your way can
be removed once your POKéMON learn\lspecific moves.
entries.pt:
▁Alguns▁dos▁obstáculos em seu▁caminho▁pode
ser▁removido▁uma▁vez que o seu POKéMON ▁aprender\l▁movimentos▁específicos.

entries.en:
POKéMON are wondrous creatures that
are shrouded in mystery. You may meet\lthem all over the world…in tall\lgrass, caves, the sea, and more.\lThey appear to grow obedient to the\lTRAINERS that caught them.
entries.pt:
POKéMON são▁criaturas▁maravilhosas que
▁estão envoltas em▁mistério.\lem▁todo o▁mundo... em▁altura\l▁grama,▁cavernas, o mar, e▁muito▁mais.\l▁Eles▁parecem▁crescer▁obedientes▁ao\l▁Os▁treinadores que▁os▁apanharam.

para eu▁estar▁aqui o tempo▁todo.\p▁Obrigado...\p▁Vou▁voltar para o POKéMON LEAGUE
